scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:capacitor && node scripts/assert-no-admin-in-dist.js && npx cap sync
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -Command "cd android; .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease"
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -Command "cd android; .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease"
scripts.ios:release: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
